guide_q: what is an extended public key and what can it derive?
note: guide_q / agent / root: the questions the page test asks the guide and one agent. The Extended keys agent covers five concepts (the extended key, its private and public forms, the base58check encoding and the fingerprint), has executed examples that decode the chapter's own xprv and xpub, and is not one of the largest agents (Deriving child keys and Implicit and explicit paths each cover seven), which the test uses for its earlier questions. The switches say what SEN0401 does not have, so the checks that need it are skipped and listed rather than failed: corpus_kinds = the kinds of passage the agents search (no textbook or course ontology); course_outcomes = a course ontology with LO-n outcomes; code_layers = concept examples that are Python programs. The last one is false for this chapter because the page builds the graph's syntax and behaviour layers from each concept's example LABEL, and chapter 5's labels are descriptions such as '12 words for 128 bits of entropy' rather than code; the 66 worked examples themselves are Python and are executed, in the page and by the chapter builder. The question bank of chapter 5 is complete (an item for every concept), so bank_complete is not set to false. The corpus_kinds switch now lists book as well: the page embeds the ontology of its own chapter of Mastering Bitcoin, 3rd edition (mastering-bitcoin-3e, at a pinned commit), so the agents really do rank over book passages and the check that counts the kinds must expect one. course_outcomes stays false until SEN0401's own course-level ontologies exist; when they do, the corpus gains a course kind too and this switch is bumped again. | 1.2.0: the course-level ontologies (profile, outcomes, textbook part, material register) now exist, so corpus.course is no longer empty: corpus_kinds gains course and course_outcomes is true. course_q/course_lo name the question the course check asks and the outcome it must retrieve, because SEN0414 asked about choosing libraries, which is not an outcome of this course. | 1.3.0: the course question is reworded in the wording of the outcome it must retrieve. The first wording was too general and the textbook ontology, which joined the corpus in page 9.27.0 and covers the same subject, outranked the outcome. | 1.4.0: code_layers is true: template 9.36.0 feeds the executed examples (n.io.code, 76 concepts in this chapter) to the syntax and behaviour extractor, so the ontology graph draws all three layers and the three-layer checks run.
